description: We are an interdisciplinary team of students from Applied Electronics, Computer Science & AI, Electronics & Communication, and Chemistry, passionate about space science, technology, and innovation. We aim to combine our diverse skills to develop creative, impactful solutions using NASA data. We welcome enthusiastic team members with interests in Python, AI/ML, data science, web development, audio processing, DSP, and UI/UX design who are excited to collaborate, learn, and innovate!
